items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He and his wife Jillian became good friends.

ctx.x: Yeah, Joe Williams & Friends. They didn’t really rehearse that, but the preparation was such and the friendship among the musicians was such that everything went off as though we had rehearsed for days, or a day, let’s say. That’s all you’d need. Less than a day. Joe was fantastic. We didn’t have to change a note. No editing. Didn’t have to drop out a tune. The program was planned as an LP, and that’s the way it went. The only thing I did was to reduce the length and volume of the applause. He got the greatest…
It’s been interesting to me to meet artists like Joe and Max Roach and how the word professional just really . . .
